messages:
Incident-Bot: PAGE -> Reserved GPU pool resv-prod-us-west-1 reporting 100% reserved utilization. queue_length=1632, avg_latency_per_req=1.9s, throttled_requests=18%. Escalation severity: P1
Sara: Ack I'm oncall. Pulling metrics now. @Ajay @Maria please standby.
Ajay: Looking, steady queue growth since 09:12 UTC, spike at 09:47. Autoscaler reported scale_attempts=3 but no new nodes added; cloud quota error in logs.
Maria: Confirming noisy tenant signal: tenant=OrchidBank has ~48% of active reservations consuming long sessions (mean runtime 42m). Other enterprise tenants impacted; seeing 429s and queued jobs.
Ryan: @Sara can you run `resvctl show resv-prod-us-west-1 --detail` and paste output? I want current reservation allocation breakdown.
Sara: run:
```
> resvctl show resv-prod-us-west-1 --detail
pool_capacity_gpus: 128
reserved_allocations:
  - OrchidBank: 62
  - BrightLeaf: 18
  - NovaHealth: 16
  - OpenSandbox: 8
free: 24
```
Sara: Free looks low and OrchidBank is anchored at 62 GPUs - heavy long-lived sessions.
Ajay: Autoscaler logs:
```
Autoscaler: scale_request -> +16 gpus
CloudProvider: quota_exceeded (gpu_quota_limit=128)
Autoscaler: plateaued, no additional capacity.
```
Ajay: autoscaler functioning but blocked by cloud quota. We're at infra limit.
Maria: impact summary from metrics: BrightLeaf queue growth +22% in last 10m, NovaHealth latency spike to 3.4s, some 429 throttles turned into retries causing backlog.
Sara: Immediate mitigation options: 1) evict idle/long-running OrchidBank sessions (soft evict) 2) route non-SLA traffic to hosted fallback region (us-east) 3) increase eviction aggressiveness for ONDEMAND sessions 4) contact CloudOps to request temporary GPU quota bump.
Ryan: Prefer soft eviction + reroute rather than blanket evictions. Customer SLAs: NovaHealth and BrightLeaf are enterprise, high priority.
Maria: Agreed. Plan: A) Identify OrchidBank sessions >30m and mark for soft-evict with 2-min drain. B) Adjust routing: non-reserved model variants -> hosted-us-east for 30m. C) Patch autoscaler policy to avoid repeated scale_attempt spam.
Sara: I'll run selector and mark sessions.
Ops-Bot: command accepted: `sessionctl --pool resv-prod-us-west-1 --tenant OrchidBank --filter "runtime>1800" --action mark_soft_evict` -> 412 sessions flagged.
Sara: Notifying OrchidBank ops via bridge: "Heads up — we're soft-evicting long sessions for 2min drain to preserve reserved pool for other enterprise tenants. Expect session restarts." @Customer Support please escalate if necessary.
Customer Support Bot: Created ticket CS-8912 and initiated customer-bridge channel with OrchidBank ops.
Ajay: Applying routing rule: `routerctl set-policy resv-prod-us-west-1 non_sla -> hosted-us-east`.
Ops-Bot: routerctl OK. Non-SLA traffic routed to hosted-us-east for 30m.
Ryan: Adjusting fairness weights: lower OrchidBank allocation target from 62 -> 48 temporarily (evict & throttling) to free headroom.
Ops-Bot: `resvctl set-allocation --pool resv-prod-us-west-1 --tenant OrchidBank --gpus 48` -> accepted. New free estimate ~36 GPUs.
Maria: Monitoring: queue_length falling 1632 -> 980 in 6 minutes, throttled_requests down to 9%. NovaHealth latency improving.
Sara: Autoscaler still blocked but mitigation freed enough. Next: request cloud quota bump to 160 GPUs asap.
Ajay: Escalating to CloudOps: @CloudOps please expedite temporary quota +40 GPUs in us-west-1. Justification: Reserved pool saturation risking enterprise SLA violations.
CloudOps-Bot: CloudOps paged. Ticket CO-11223 created. ETA 25-40 minutes (manual review required).
Ryan: Enable emergency evict policy for sessions older than 60m if queue doesn't drop in 10m.
Sara: Noted. Handing off to night oncall if stable. Plan: continue monitoring, keep routing active, maintain customer bridge, follow CloudOps result.
OrchidBank Ops (customer-bridge): "We see our jobs restarting — a small number of failures but acceptable compared to full queue stall. Please keep us updated."
Maria: Update 09:58 UTC queue_length=470, throttled=3%, NovaHealth latency ~0.9s. BrightLeaf queue elevated but tolerable.
Sara: Mitigation working. Keeping routing for 30m then evaluate rollback. If CloudOps grants quota, we'll scale and restore allocations.
Ajay: Postmortem notes: root cause = cloud quota + single-tenant long-running sessions (noisy neighbor) + autoscaler didn't preempt long sessions. Action items: 1) add tenant fairshare controller 2) autoscaler should surface quota-block reason earlier and trigger fallback 3) add alert for reserved pool headroom <20%.
Ryan: Add runbook step: immediate reroute to hosted fallback as first mitigation.
Ops-Bot: CloudOps response: CO-11223 -> manual approval granted. Temporary GPU quota +32 approved, expected allocation visible in 18 minutes.
Sara: Once quota attaches, we'll scale +24 GPUs and rebalance allocations back. I'll coordinate scale and close customer bridge afterwards.
Customer Support Bot: CS-8912 updated with mitigation timeline and customer notifications.
Sara: Handing off to night oncall: @Michael you're up. Current status: pool stabilized, queue dropping, CloudOps approved temporary quota arriving. Monitor `resv-prod-us-west-1` for 4 hours and notify if queue >700 again.
Michael: Ack. Taking over. Will keep channel open and update at top of hour. Good job team :thumbsup:
Incident-Bot: Incident P1 -> status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident attrs: reserved_pool=resv-prod-us-west-1, cause=noisy_tenant+quota_block, mitigation=soft_eviction+routing+quota_bump, owner=Sara, bridge=CS-8912
